inputs.share_count_basis: 3,708,361,809 ordinary shares (A + H) at 30-Jun-2026 (H1 2026 interim, share capital line); diluted EPS equals basic EPS in every period since FY2023, so there are no dilutive instruments. Held FLAT: SBC is nil and the company has not issued shares since the 2022 placement to Yunnan Baiyao.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30-Jun-2026. total_debt = short-term borrowings 46,528.5 + non-current liabilities due within one year 1,703.5 + other current liabilities (parent commercial paper) 6,153.1 + long-term borrowings 3,277.1 = 57,662.3, LESS the current lease liability 482.9 inside the due-within-one-year line (treatment B keeps leases out of debt) = 57,179.4. cash = cash and bank balances 36,573.0 less truly restricted balances 2,534 (bill margin deposits 1,845 + LC margin 35 + other restricted 654; the 1,755 of >3-month time deposits is kept) plus held-for-trading structured deposits 9,416.9 = 43,456.0. Net debt 13,723.4.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report note (IV)44 capital reserve: share-based payment expense nil in 2025 (RMB0.3m in 2024, RMB4.6m in 2023); the 2020 restricted-share plan has run off. SBC-zero filer -- rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.175 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-22 02:21Z). Direction check: per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by 1.175 to give HKD, the H-share quote currency. Parity: the A-share 601607.SS traded at CNY 16.23 on 2026-10-22 (= HKD 19.07 at this rate) against the H-share print, so the H-share trades at a ~42% discount to the A-share -- a typical A/H SOE discount, not an FX error; A and H are the same ordinary share with the same dividend, so the per-share basis matches. refresh_price.py moves the price but never fx_rate -- refresh the rate on the next rebuild.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-22T02:05:51Z (10:05 HKT, intraday regular session on HKEX; replace at the regular close). 52-week range HKD 10.70-12.41.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta 1.0 (defensive, policy-tendered pharma distribution; low operating volatility but thin margins and SOE governance) x 6.5% ERP for Chinese equities incl. country premium = 8.4% cost of equity. After-tax cost of debt 2.3% (FY2025 interest expense 1,686 on ~56bn average gross borrowings = 3.0% pre-tax, x (1-25%)). Weights 80/20 equity/debt on a net-debt basis (net debt 13.7bn vs ~60bn A-share market cap; the 46bn of short-term borrowings funds a 91bn receivables book and is largely offset by cash and structured deposits). 0.8 x 8.4 + 0.2 x 2.3 = 7.2%, rounded to 7.0%. Same rate in all three scenarios: VBP/pricing, impairment and governance risk are priced in the scenario flows and the 30% bear weight, not stacked into the discount rate (adaptations 7f). Gordon at 7%/2% would imply ~20x terminal FCF, so the 12x cap binds in the base case -- the valuation is a capped-multiple on year-10 attributable owner FCF, not a perpetuity.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B) leases as operating cost: the IFRS-16/CAS-21 lease payment (FY2025 principal 815.8 per note (IV)65 'cash payments for settlement of lease liabilities' + ~75 lease interest inside finance cost = ~890, 0.31% of revenue) is charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path, and lease liabilities (1,473.8 non-current + 482.9 current at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from total_debt. D&A for the cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 D&A 3,060.6 less ROU depreciation 744.4 = 2,316.2 (0.82% of revenue), so the lease is charged once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are made ATTRIBUTABLE via the leakage rate: cash_tax_rate_path 45% = 1 - (1 - 30% income tax) x (1 - 22% NCI share of NOPAT). Income tax 30% is the FY2023-25 effective rate ex non-recurring items (26.8%, 26.8%, ~32%; 25% statutory lifted by non-deductibles and un-recognised subsidiary losses). NCI share: FY2025 minority profit 1,249 on normalised NOPAT ~6,100 = 20.5%, lifted to 22% for the first full year of 60%-owned Shanghai Hutchison (consolidated from 25-Apr-2025). No NCI deduction in the bridge (book NCI 14,437.8 at 30-Jun-2026 is NOT subtracted) -- charged once. FY0 tie-out: FY2025 revenue 283,580 x (3.95% - 0.31% lease - 0.82% D&A) = EBIT 8,000 x 0.55 = 4,400 attributable NOPAT, less attributable after-tax net finance cost ~770 = ~3,630 attributable net profit, between the CSRC-basis underlying attributable profit of 2,981 (which keeps the lumpy FY2025 impairments of 1,594 and strips 366 of recurring-type grants) and FY2024's underlying 4,065 -- within normalisation noise.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component route (SKILL.md routing: operating company, non-US, thin-margin distributor -> owner-fcf.md + owner-fcf-adaptations.md for currency, leases, NCI, matching-asset and SBC-zero). Not a bank/insurer/REIT: Shanghai Pharmaceuticals is China's #2 pharmaceutical distributor (91% of revenue at 5.8% gross margin) with a 9% manufacturing segment at 57% gross margin and a 3% retail arm; 10-year horizon because the FCF margin is still moving with the manufacturing mix shift and the working-capital drain. BASE YEAR: FY2025 reported EBITDA (PBT + net interest + D&A = 14,161) contains the ~RMB2.9bn one-off remeasurement gain on consolidating Shanghai Hutchison (CSRC non-recurring total 3,643 pre-tax / 2,744 attributable after tax and NCI); the FY2026 EBITDA margin anchor of 3.95% is built from FY2025 PBT less non-recurring items, plus financial expenses and D&A, LESS income from associates/JVs (284) and dividend income (57) whose source assets go into the equity bridge (matching-asset rule), plus ~700 for the above-normal FY2025 impairment charge and the recurring-type grants CSRC strips. Same basis gives 3.96% for FY2024, and H1 2026 underlying attributable profit grew 18%. OWNER FCF FY0: reported FCF 3,828.3 (CAS operating cash flow 6,154.2, which is before interest paid and after taxes paid, less capex 2,325.9) minus SBC 0 minus interest income 405.0 = 3,423.4 -- this is CONSOLIDATED and pre-lease-principal; the engine's component build is attributable (45% leakage) and post-lease, so the projected year-1 figure is below it by construction. WORKING CAPITAL: a distributor with receivables (90.8bn) + inventories (42.7bn) > payables (56.6bn + 7.0bn notes); the cash-flow working-capital change was -4,548 (FY2022), -4,150 (FY2023), -4,236 (FY2024), -3,817 (FY2025) on revenue increases of +16.2bn, +28.3bn, +15.0bn, +8.3bn = -28%, -15%, -28%, -46% capture; base uses -25% of the revenue CHANGE, bull -20%, bear -35%. BUYBACKS: none; the 'stock repurchase option' liability is the put on the run-off employee share plan. DIVIDENDS: FY2025 total RMB0.47/share (1,743m, 30% payout); the RMB0.35 final (1,298m) was still in dividends payable at 30-Jun-2026 and is deducted in the bridge; H1 2026 interim RMB0.10. DISCOUNT TIMING: flows are discounted end-of-year from FY2026, which over-discounts by ~10 months against the 22-Oct-2026 valuation date (~5% of EV); the bridge deducts the H1 2026 attributable owner FCF already inside the 30-Jun net debt so the FY2026 flow is not counted twice -- the two roughly offset and neither is tuned. HOUSE = STREET: SBC is zero so the two bases coincide and band_position is null.
inputs.fcf_history_note: Owner FCF series (reported FCF less interest income; SBC nil throughout): FY2019 3,035; FY2020 3,547; FY2021 604; FY2022 1,620; FY2023 1,799; FY2024 2,904; FY2025 3,423 (consolidated, pre-lease-principal, pre-NCI). FY2018 OCF is on the old HK-GAAP basis (after interest paid) and is excluded from the series.

FY2026 is projected in full as year 1, so without this the first half would be counted twice. Offsets the end-of-year discounting of FY2026 from an October valuation date (see inputs.notes).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: revenue 3-yr CAGR 6.9% (FY2022-25) decelerating to +3.0% in FY2025 and +4.2% in H1 2026; base path averages ~3.3% over ten years
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5-yr CAGR 10.8% diverges from EPS 5-yr CAGR -0.5% and revenue 8.1%: the FY2022 equity jump (49.4bn -> 67.1bn) is the A-share placement that lifted the share count from 2,842m to 3,698m, not retained earnings; the 3-yr equity CAGR of 4.2% is the organic rate. Headline EPS CAGRs are distorted by the FY2025 one-off (reported 1.54 vs ~0.80 ex non-recurring on the CSRC basis).
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF less interest income, SBC nil): FY2022 1,620 -> FY2025 3,423 (+28% p.a., off a depressed FY2022 base) and FY2020 3,547 -> FY2025 3,423 (-0.7% p.a.). Reported FCF CAGRs are 23% and 0% respectively -- no SBC wedge, the only adjustment is interest income. Cash generation has not grown in five years despite revenue +48%: working-capital absorption of ~4bn a year is the reason, and it is modelled explicitly.

base.narrative: Revenue +4.5% in FY2026 (H1 +4.2%, innovative-drug commercialisation +29% and import agency +15% outgrowing base distribution) fading to 2.5% as VBP price deflation offsets ageing-driven volume. EBITDA margin (ex associates, pre-lease) edges from 3.95% to 4.1% as the 57%-gross-margin manufacturing segment (full-year Hutchison) grows faster than 5.8%-gross-margin distribution. Lease 0.31%, D&A ex-ROU 0.80%, capex 0.85% (FY2024-25 0.82-0.87%), 45% combined tax + NCI leakage, working capital absorbs 25% of each year's revenue increase. Terminal: 12x year-10 attributable owner FCF (cap binds; Gordon at 7%/2% would be ~20x).

bull.narrative: Mix shift works: manufacturing and the CSO/innovative-drug service lines keep compounding high-single-digit, the eleventh-batch VBP rules and the commercial-insurance innovative-drug catalogue ease the deflation, impairments normalise and the EBITDA margin recovers to 4.7% (still below the 5.4% of FY2020-22). Better inventory and payables discipline (H1 2026 OCF 4.45bn) trims working-capital absorption to 20% of growth. Terminal 13x.

bear.narrative: Distribution gross margin keeps sliding (5.79% in FY2025, -0.15pp YoY) under VBP and DRG payment reform, tender losses like the FY2025 hydroxychloroquine loss recur, goodwill/receivable impairments stay at the FY2025 level (1.6bn) and the EBITDA margin settles at 3.5%. Hospital receivable days lengthen so working capital absorbs 35% of growth; revenue growth fades to 1.5%. Terminal 10x on a 1% perpetuity.

scenario_narratives.base: A policy-tendered, thin-margin distributor growing a little slower than China's drug-spend volume, with the manufacturing mix nudging margins up 15bp over five years and a working-capital drain that keeps attributable owner FCF at roughly 1-1.3% of revenue. Value is a 12x multiple on year-10 FCF, not a perpetuity.
scenario_narratives.bull: Manufacturing (Hutchison TCM brands, Shexiang Baoxin), CSO and innovative-drug commercialisation outgrow the base for a decade, VBP deflation moderates, impairments normalise; margin 4.7%, growth 6% fading to 3%, 13x exit.
scenario_narratives.bear: VBP/DRG deflation compounds through the 91% distribution book, impairments recur, receivable days stretch; margin 3.5%, growth 1.5%, 10x exit. Still cash-generative -- no scenario hits the zero floor.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because 91% of revenue sits in a 5.8%-gross-margin business whose prices are set by a single regulator (NHSA/VBP), underlying attributable profit fell 27% in FY2025 on the CSRC basis before recovering in H1 2026, and the SOE controller's capital allocation (M&A-led, 30% payout) is not minority-driven. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things -- sustained mix shift, moderating VBP deflation and normalised impairments -- to hold for a decade.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Shanghai Pharmaceuticals is valued as what it is: a working-capital-intensive wholesaler with a small high-margin manufacturing arm, where a 10bp move in the consolidated EBITDA margin is worth about RMB0.3bn of EBIT on RMB284bn of revenue. The model strips the FY2025 Hutchison remeasurement gain, charges leases as an operating cost, makes the flows attributable through a 45% combined tax-and-minority leakage, and models the receivables/inventory drain on the change in revenue rather than assuming it away. The terminal value is capped at 12x year-10 attributable FCF -- the house Gordon value at a 7% CNY WACC would be ~20x and no buyer of a Chinese SOE distributor pays that. The H-share trades at a ~42% discount to the A-share; the value here is per ordinary share in HKD at the H-share quote, and the discount is a market feature, not a valuation input.
key_risks_to_valuation: EBITDA margin anchor: FY2025 underlying profit is ambiguous (company's own one-off deduction gives 4,721 attributable; CSRC non-recurring basis gives 2,981); the 3.95% anchor sits between, and each 10bp is ~RMB0.25/share
Working-capital capture of -25% of revenue growth: at -46% (FY2025 actual) the base FCF roughly halves; at -15% (FY2023) it rises ~40%
VBP/DRG pricing: a further 50bp of distribution gross-margin erosion wipes out the whole modelled margin expansion
Impairments: FY2025 asset + credit impairments 1,594 vs 840 in FY2024; if the higher level is the new normal, the base margin is ~25bp too high
Discount-rate and terminal cap: the 12x cap binds in base and bull; the valuation is effectively 12x FCF, so the result scales linearly with the cap
NCI leakage 22% of NOPAT assumes Hutchison and the JV-structured distribution subsidiaries stay at current ownership; buy-ins would raise attributable share but cost cash
FX: a 5% CNY move against the HKD moves every HKD figure 5%; fx_rate is not refreshed by refresh_price.py
